title: Shinonome Akito — One-Act Morning Practice〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: One early morning
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Shinonome, good morning!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we're all here. We'll start our morning practice once we've warmed up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Toya
rows.Line:
Okay!
Okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, let's do some stretches together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, mind if I take a moment before we start stretching? I'd like to drink that thing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, same here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, you guys brought more energy jelly today? It's like everyone's drinking that stuff now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They make for ideal breakfast substitutes because they go down smoothly even when it's warm out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, this is really your breakfast?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. My mom's been busy and has been coming home very late recently, so I'd rather not ask her to do more by waking up early to make some for me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I know what you mean.
You want her to rest since she's probably really tired.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hang on...
Kohane, did you not have any breakfast today?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I did. I asked my parents to buy bread and jam for me, so I had some of that today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I suppose I could do the same.
Spreading jam over bread seems simple enough.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What about you, Akito?
I figured you had a full meal before coming here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I took a quick look what was in the fridge and fixed myself a light breakfast.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, you can make your own food?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Just fried eggs and salads mostly.
Oh, and some bread to go along with that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that is pretty light.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I tend to want to eat a lot since I feel like I need to in order to get my voice going.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You eat a lot regardless of the time of day. Morning, noon or night.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Har har. Joke's on you. I work it all off throughout the day by singing!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But the part about eating a lot...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She didn't deny that fact...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still... It's important to eat three meals per day! I'm sure it's good for your health!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly! See, Kohane gets it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, I sorta get it too.
I used to eat a ton before I started going out for runs.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, you run?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's news to me too.
When did this happen?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pretty recently.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I have to work harder than anyone else...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's why I decided that I'm gonna do everything I absolutely can.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't give me that look. I promise not to go overboard.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm having a hard time finding the time to actually go for runs, so I've decided to get off two stations early and run the rest of the way to morning practices.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: T-Two-stations?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. That's why I have a light breakfast, which is why I need this energy jelly to hold me over until lunch.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everything you can, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, nothing. You're just as self-disciplined as ever, I guess.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Kohane, wanna try going for a run sometime?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd like to increase my stamina too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I didn't exercise at all in junior high, so I probably have the least out of all of us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case, I'd like to join you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I haven't exercised much up until now either.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They call me the self-disciplined one, but they better not get carried away themselves.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, why don't we all go for a run together? Nonogi Park's got plenty of trees and shade, so it shouldn't be too bad even when it's hot out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really? I'd like that a lot.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, sounds good!
Let's all go for a run next time!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure.
